'''Mos Shirare''' is a city-fortress in [[Shienar]].

Mos Shirare sends forces with the rest of Shienar to [[Tarwin's Gap]] to battle the [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|1|48}} After that battle, when [[Siuan Sanche]] and her party arrive in [[Fal Dara]], Lord [[Agelmar Jagad]] informs her that a bard from Mos Shirare is coming to Fal Dara for her entertainment.{{ref/book|2|9}}
